title: Review suppliers, orders and supply risk each month

steps.do: Update each purchase order's status and delivery date from the supplier's confirmations and what arrived, and flag any order that is late or short.
List suppliers whose re-evaluation is due or whose deliveries were late or defective, and prepare a keep, condition or suspend decision for each.
For each bottleneck or strategic item with a single source, propose a second source, buffer stock or accepting the risk, and bring the order of that work to the product lead.
Where stock on hand will not cover demand over the supplier's lead time, draft a reorder as a purchase order with its total, for the founder to approve and send.

done_criteria.check: Is every drafted order either approved by a person or open as a spend decision, and every late order flagged?
